properties.formula: AG atom("every actor instance has declared positive inbound and outbound capacities; sending to a full queue sleeps without mutation until capacity is available; blocking receive from an empty queue sleeps until a message exists")

properties.name: closed_queues_drain_to_completion
properties.expression: close is idempotent and forbids every later push; already-buffered messages remain readable in order; blocked senders wake with rejection; receivers report closed only after the buffer is empty; queue iteration terminates exactly at closed and empty
properties.formula: AG atom("close is idempotent and forbids every later push; already-buffered messages remain readable in order; blocked senders wake with rejection; receivers report closed only after the buffer is empty; queue iteration terminates exactly at closed and empty")

properties.name: parameters_cascade_through_grammar
